title: Juicy Roasted Korean Beef Jeon
description: A monsoon Korean dish featuring roasted beef, infused with oil for a snappy texture, and low sodium content, formed into a jeon.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger.
Add the sliced beef to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the marinated beef to the flour mixture and mix until the beef is well coated.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the coated beef to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the beef from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Serve the beef jeon hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
